svg.title: What the dream looked at
svg.desc: Top: one benchmark store, 114 explicit conclusions from oldest to newest. The dream's agents asked for the newest twenty. The old value of the question, '20 titles', is row 48; the new value, '25 titles', is row 88: both outside the twenty. The dream wrote three deductions and two patterns, about sleep, glaciology and journalism, the topics of the newest rows. Bottom: in the 41 stores where both values could be located, the newest twenty rows held both values in none, the new value only in 21, the old value only in 3, and neither in 17. Across all 67 stores: 7,434 explicit conclusions, 158 deductive, none of which records a change, 146 inductive, and no contradictions.
svg.text: A dream agent sees what its tools return. On the benchmark it asked for the newest twenty conclusions and never
searched, so it rarely saw a fact and its change together.
“How many titles are currently on my to-watch list?”
What the dream wrote for this store: three deductions and two patterns, about sleep hygiene, Antarctic glaciology and long-form
journalism, the topics of its newest rows. Nothing about the list.
the newest twenty explicit rows of each store held
in the 41 of 67 stores where both values could be found by their text
none records a change of value
